title: Flesh of the One
description:
Your body comes from one of your two parent Species: its Size, its height and its Movement are yours. The first time you memorise this Skill, choose that Species and, if it has any, one of its subspecies or regional origins. If it offers more than one Size, keep one.

For every Prerequisite, you count as a character of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin. Also choose one Skill from those of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin: it is Memorised without taking up any Memory and does not have to be bought. You can no longer change it. If that Species does not fix for itself what you inherit from it, as with Undead and Scothans, settle it with the GM.

Every point of Constitution, every Vitality Level and every other source of maximum HP grants you 2 fewer than it would grant any other character, to a minimum of 0. A Vitality Level therefore grants you 3 instead of 5, or 4 instead of 6 when a Skill raises it to 6, and a point of Constitution grants you 0 instead of 2. A negative Constitution takes away as much as it would from any other character. Your base of 20 maximum HP does not change.

You cannot choose the same Species for {{Blood of the Other}}.
